summaryZh: Solinftec宣布其Solix自主田间机器人平台在2026年商业季取得重大突破：超100台机器人在美国13个州和波多黎各作业，覆盖超5.5万英亩，平均减少化学药剂使用85%。公司同步推进自主补给站商业化，并计划推出四款动力版本机型，其中柴油版XR将于2027年上市。

contentFull:
Solinftec expands Solix fleet after 85% average chemical reduction

 26-08 | Crop solutions | Field robots | Weed/Pest control | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The docking station, introduced in 2024, allows Solix Ag Robotics to refill autonomously and continue operating without a manual refill. In the 2026 season, Solix robots completed more than 1,700 autonomous refills through July. – Photo: Solinftec

More than 100 Solinftec Solix robots operated across the US and Puerto Rico in 2026, covering over 55,000 acres and reducing chemical use by an average of 85%. Solinftec is now scaling up autonomous refilling and preparing three additional Solix models, including a larger diesel-powered version for 2027. 

Solinftec will present the latest developments of its Solix autonomous field robot platform at the Farm Progress Show, September 1–3 in Boone, Iowa. The company reports its largest US commercial season so far.

Through July 2026, more than 100 Solix robots were operating in 13 US states and Puerto Rico. Together, they covered 55,427 acres (22,431 hectares), 15 times the acreage covered three years ago. According to Solinftec, the robots monitored more than 95 million individual plants.

The company reports an average chemical-use reduction of 85%. Across the growing fleet and acreage, reductions ranged from 83% to 89%. Solix uses cameras and Solinftec’s ALICE artificial intelligence platform to scout crops and weeds and carry out targeted applications.

More than 1,700 autonomous refills

A significant development in 2026 is the first full commercial season of Solinftec’s autonomous Refill Station. The station allows a Solix robot to dock, refill its tank and return to the field without an operator travelling to the machine.

Through July, Solix robots completed more than 1,700 autonomous refills, transferring more than 45,000 US gallons (170,000 litres) of product. One station refilled its robot more than 120 times during the season.

Solinftec has also increased the travel speed of its solar-powered robot from 1 to 2 mph (1.6 to 3.2 km/h) by updating the motors and software.

Four Solix models planned

Solinftec is expanding Solix into a four-model platform with different power sources and tank capacities. The solar-electric Solix X1 will be joined by the battery-electric XT, gas/diesel-powered XR and hybrid-electric XC. Capacities will range from 50 to 1,200 US gallons (189 to 4,542 litres).

Depending on the model, the robots will support targeted spraying or a combination of targeted and broadcast applications. All four will use the ALICE AI platform.

The diesel/gas-powered Solix XR will be previewed at the Farm Progress Show and is expected to become commercially available for the 2027 season. Solinftec says it plans to deploy approximately 200 robots and another 80 autonomous Refill Stations in 2027.

Solix priced at $55,000 (€47,000)

The current Solix robot is priced at approximately $55,000 (€47,000). Solinftec claims the investment can be recovered in around 2.5 years through input savings alone. This is the manufacturer’s calculation and does not include potential savings in labour, fuel or machinery use.

Solinftec will also launch an Amazon store for selected Solix replacement parts, allowing growers to carry out more routine repairs themselves with remote support from the manufacturer.

translationZh:
Solinftec将在9月1日至3日于爱荷华州布恩举行的Farm Progress Show上展示其Solix自主田间机器人平台的最新进展。该公司报告称，这是其迄今最大的美国商业季。

截至2026年7月，超过100台Solix机器人在美国13个州和波多黎各运营。它们共同覆盖了55,427英亩（22,431公顷）的土地，是三年前覆盖面积的15倍。据Solinftec称，这些机器人监测了超过9500万株个体植物。

该公司报告称，平均化学药剂使用量减少了85%。在整个不断增长的车队和作业面积中，减少幅度在83%至89%之间。Solix使用摄像头和Solinftec的ALICE人工智能平台来侦察作物和杂草，并执行靶向施药。

**超过1700次自主补给**

2026年的一个重要进展是Solinftec自主补给站的首个完整商业季。该站点允许Solix机器人停靠、加满其药箱并返回田间，无需操作员前往机器处。

截至7月，Solix机器人完成了超过1700次自主补给，转移了超过45,000美制加仑（170,000升）的药剂产品。一个补给站在该季为其机器人补给超过120次。

Solinftec还通过更新电机和软件，将其太阳能机器人的行进速度从1英里/小时（1.6公里/小时）提高到2英里/小时（3.2公里/小时）。

**计划推出四款Solix机型**

Solinftec正在将Solix扩展为一个包含四种机型的平台，采用不同的动力源和药箱容量。太阳能电动Solix X1将加入电池电动XT、燃气/柴油动力XR和混合动力XC。容量范围将从50到1,200美制加仑（189到4,542升）。

根据机型不同，这些机器人将支持靶向喷洒或靶向与全面喷洒相结合。所有四款机型都将使用ALICE AI平台。

柴油/燃气动力的Solix XR将在Farm Progress Show上预览，预计将于2027年商业上市。Solinftec表示，计划在2027年部署约200台机器人和另外80个自主补给站。

**Solix定价55,000美元（47,000欧元）**

目前的Solix机器人定价约为55,000美元（47,000欧元）。Solinftec声称，仅通过节省投入品，这项投资即可在大约2.5年内收回。这是制造商的计算结果，不包括劳动力、燃料或机械使用方面的潜在节省。

Solinftec还将推出一个亚马逊商店，销售精选的Solix替换零件，使种植者能够在制造商的远程支持下自行进行更多常规维修。
